items.title: Окна 1
items.prompt:
Subject
Exterior view of a building facade at night with a static grid of 12 windows. Each window has glowing warm amber curtains and black frames. Behind each curtain there is a dark human silhouette.
Scene style
Warm cinematic night atmosphere, intimate domestic life, realistic silhouettes, strong contrast, elegant readable motion.
Camera
Locked-off static camera.
No camera movement.
No zoom.
No pan.
No tilt.
No dolly.
No parallax.
Main rule
All 12 silhouettes must be visibly animated.
No static windows.
Motion should be energetic, expressive, clearly readable, and larger in amplitude than subtle natural movement, while still believable.
Actions  
- woman actively tossing and gathering her hair with strong arm and head motion
- elderly man clearly opening, lifting, adjusting, and shifting his newspaper
- child making a high energetic jump with arms spread
- hugging couple swaying broadly and shifting weight visibly
- dancer making a wide expressive dance movement with arms and torso
- man with raised hand keeping the arm raised and clearly waving side to side with hand and forearm; he must wave, not lower the arm
- mother actively lifting and rocking the baby
- violinist playing with broad bow strokes and visible upper-body movement
- girl on the phone turning her head and gesturing clearly while talking
- elderly couple at the table talking animatedly with visible hand and head gestures
- person watering the plant bending clearly and noticeably tilting the watering can
- child throwing a paper airplane forward with a strong visible gesture
Paper airplane rule
The paper airplane flies naturally forward in a smooth arc.
It must not reverse direction.
It must not fly backward into the hand like reversed footage.
Environment constraints
Keep the 12-window grid, black frames, curtains, warm amber backlight, composition, and perspective unchanged.
Preserve each silhouette’s identity, proportions, and position inside its own window.
No silhouettes crossing into other windows.
Curtains remain almost still.
Loop rule
Create a seamless loop.
The final frame must match the first frame exactly.
The motion should feel cyclical and continuous.
Negative
camera movement, zoom, pan, tilt, dolly, parallax, flickering light, changing window geometry, moving frames, morphing silhouettes, frozen windows, static waving man, lowering arm instead of waving, tiny motion, extra people, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, silhouettes crossing between windows, reverse airplane motion, airplane flying back into hand, jump cuts, broken loop
